{{Quote|You can use the Force to speed up, both physically and mentally, allowing you more time to make decisions.|Kyle Katarn|<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />}}
'''Force speed''', also known as '''burst of speed''' or '''Force sprint''', or '''Force reflex''', was a core [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed the user to maintain sprinting speeds for a brief [[Time/Legends|time]]. Greater aptitude granted greater boosts to speed and/or greater duration. The increased speed of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] enabled the individual to perceive and react to the world and the entities around them in slow motion, allowing them to dodge attacks easily and attack more quickly with greater accuracy.

The technique was commonly used by many [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-users throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]], including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], and the [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] order, an organization of [[Force Adept|Force adepts]] who used the physical body to channel the Force. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Jedi used the ability to great effect on the battlefields. It was also commonly used to increase speed during [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duels]] as well as in [[Unarmed combat/Legends|unarmed combat]]. According to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tionne Solusar]]'s [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force|tome]] regarding the Force, there was a drawback to using this power; using Force speed had a draining effect on a Force-user's energy and metabolism, and required a longer recovery period.

==Description==
Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to increase one's speed was a common [[Force power/Legends|ability]] among many [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] throughout history, with many able to both use the Force to increase their muscle speed and to slow down their perception of the world. The increased speed of the Force-user enabled them to see the world and the entities around them in slow motion, allowing them to dodge attacks easily and attack more quickly with greater accuracy.<ref name="Revised Core Rules" /><ref name="Core Rules">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> With sufficient skill in this ability, one could actually run on vertical surfaces for brief periods of time.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

According to [[Tionne Solusar]]'s [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force|tome]] regarding the Force written at the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Force speed would only be achieved after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] used the Force to attune their entire body with their heightened reflexes. The power could be used with such velocity that they appeared to simply vanish from their previous position. If the user was in unarmed combat, they could use it to swiftly bring an end to a skirmish. However, there was a drawback to using this power; using Force speed had a draining effect on a Force-user's energy and metabolism, and required a longer recovery period.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

A core Force ability,<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" /> Force speed fell under the control area of the Force,<ref name="Revised Core Rules" /> which was the first aspect of the Force taught to [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]].<ref name="TJP">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Force speed was referred to by different names throughout history including burst of speed,<ref name="Revised Core Rules" /> burst run,<ref name="TCGAoD BR" /> Force run,<ref name="TCGCoftF FR" /> Force sprint,<ref name="GambitStealth" /> heightened speed,<ref name="TCGCoftF HS" /> Force dash,<ref name="Kinect Star Wars" /> Force quickness,<ref name="Star Wars: Epic Duels" /> and Surge.<ref name="Roleplaying Game: Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

==Applications==
{{Quote|The burst of speed that I experienced was not a fluke, but unlike other Force powers, I cannot say I felt in complete control of it.|Luke Skywalker reflecting on his experience with Force speed|<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" />}}
Increasing sprinting speeds by using the Force to augment the muscles was commonly used by both [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], such as when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Kaox Krul]] used this [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] to chase [[Crian Maru]] and [[Dree Vandap]], who were on a speeder.<ref name="Darkness Shared" /> In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Relin Druur]] used the power when he [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attacked]] the [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']], which was [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Lignan crystal]]s in the [[Phaegon system/Legends|Phaegon system]], and, by his own estimate, he was able to cross 100 meters in a second, running in a blur.<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was a great adept of force speed, using it with deadly precision during his [[Massacre at the Gran Protectorate Embassy|mission]] to kill the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Pax Teem]] by killing a pair of [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] guards at such speed that seemed to be a blur for [[Human/Legends|Human]] senses and a phantom to security cameras.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

[[File:Force_speed_TPM.png|thumb|left|320px|Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi using Force speed to escape [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].]]
The Jedi [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were also known to be skilled in this ability, using it to escape from [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> This technique was not limited to the Jedi and Sith however; the Force-using [[Matukai/Legends|Matukai]] who focused on channeling the Force through their bodies, were highly skilled in sustaining agility based motions using the Force.<ref name="HG" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many Jedi used this ability to great effect on the battlefields, as seen when Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] used this technique to gain momentum for a long-distance [[Force jump/Legends|Force Jump]] he was about to perform during the [[Battle of Dantooine (Clone Wars)|Battle of Dantooine]],<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 13">{{CW|13}}</ref> as well as to augment his fighting ability against [[Kar Vastor]] on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]].<ref name="Shatterpoint" />

Jedi could also use the Force to augment their muscles and increase the speed of their movements during combat, heightening their reflexes and increasing the speed of their blocks and blows during engagements. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was proficient in this application of the power, often using the Force to increase the speed of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes,<ref name="ELIRD">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines I: Rebel Dream]]''</ref> as seen during his duels with [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Supreme Overlord]] [[Shimrra Jamaane]]<ref name="UF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref> and [[Raynar Thul|UnuThul]].<ref name="TSW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> During their [[Showdown on Coruscant|duel]], Jedi Master Mace Windu and [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] both showed considerable skill in this ability, both moving in a blur. In particular, Mace Windu's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber form]] [[Form VII/Legends|Vaapad]] relied on using the Force in this way as in combat it would appear as if he was wielding dozens of swords at once.<ref name="RotSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> However, prolonged use of the Force to increase their speed could leave the user dangerously tired.<ref name="GambitStealth" />

[[File:Katarnspeed.png|thumb|right|200px|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]] using Force speed.]]
Slowing down their perception of the world would give a Force-user more time to react to a situation as Luke Skywalker discovered in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during his confrontation with the [[human replica droid]] [[Guri]] in [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] [[Xizor's Palace|Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. With guidance from the voice of Ben Kenobi, Luke gave in to the Force and found that time seemed to slow down considerably, allowing him to dodge the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin's]] attack and defeat her with ease.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire (novel)">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Luke would later remark to his students at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] that he didn't feel in control of this power and instead felt that it was the Force guiding his actions.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force" />

==Users==
===Force-users of the Republic===
Using the Force to increase the speed of movement was a common ability among many Force-users throughout [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]], particularly among Jedi such as [[Johun Othone]],<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn,<ref name="TPM" /> as well as Sith such as Kaox Krul,<ref name="Darkness Shared" /> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]],<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> and [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].<ref name="DMSH">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref><ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref> Jedi Relin Druur regularly drew upon the Force to augment his speed, during duels and skirmishes. During their final fight, Druur and Sith Lord [[Saes Rrogon]] moved at a speed that was blurry even to Druur's eyes.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> A Sith Lord in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reformed Sith Empire]], [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] was capable of increasing his speed with the Force, moving at a blinding speed while dodging an attack by mercenaries on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> During the [[Great Galactic War]], the Jedi Knight [[Aryn Leneer]] was a skilled user of Force speed and was able to slow her perception of time so she could time a hyperspace jump perfectly when attempting to infiltrate Coruscant after the [[Sacking of Coruscant|Sith assault]] on the planet. She also drew on the Force to augment her speed during engagements. The Sith Lord [[Darth Malgus]] was also proficient in augmenting his speed with the Force and used it during many battles such as the Sith assault on Coruscant and his duel with Leneer.<ref name="ToR:D">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref>

===The Clone Wars and the rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|My connection to the Force has improved since the last time we met. If I concentrate, I can heighten my reflexes and slow the world around me.''"<br />"''Great! Then start using the Force to keep these fighters offa me!|[[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>}}[[File:Jedi_reflexes.png|thumb|left|320px|Qui-Gon Jinn uses Force speed to catch Jar Jar Binks' tongue.]]
With the Jedi called to arms in the Clone Wars, many Jedi would use this ability during the many battles of the conflict to aid in combat. The [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Mace Windu,<ref name="Shatterpoint" /><ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 13" /> Obi-Wan Kenobi,<ref name="LoE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]],<ref name="DOP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref> and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]],<ref name="BFII" /> were all known to use the Force to enhance their speed in battle. Anakin Skywalker's Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was also capable of this technique, using it to outrun [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Kidd Kareen]] in a foot race across a bridge on the planet [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]].<ref name="crashcourse">''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref> Another Padawan, the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Nuru Kungurama]], was able to run so fast his feet appeared to barely touch the ground when using this ability.<ref name="breakout">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref> Jedi Master [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] showed a high level of skill in this ability when engaging a [[JK-13 security droid|Jedi Killer droid]] on [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]], moving in a blur of motion that baffled even the experienced gaze of Obi-Wan Kenobi. He later used this technique to dodge blaster fire and reach a family of four who were cornered by one of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="TCD">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> The Human female Jedi Master [[Taria Damsin]] used Force sprint while defending the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Torbel]] on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] from a squad of battle droids.<ref name="seige">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref> The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] was also known to have used this ability while fighting the other gladiators in [[the Cauldron]].<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 6">{{CW|6}}</ref> Jedi Masters [[Roan Shryne]], [[Bol Chatak]] and Padawan [[Olee Starstone]] also used the Force to enhance their speed to put some distance between them and the [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]] who were pursuing them after the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. Shryne would later use this ability to flee Darth Vader during the attempt to rescue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]].<ref name="RoDV">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

Just before the Clone Wars, [[Mission to rescue Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|when Anakin slaughtered]] the [[Rrhr hunting band]] Tuskan tribe, the enraged Jedi augmented his speed with the Force, in addition to the other applications of the Force he used in the rampage.<ref>[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' {{C|novelization}}]]</ref> Another user of the art of Force reflex in that time was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] who, commonly employed it while flying her prototype [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] in battle in the days just before and during the dawn of the Clone Wars. Drawing on this power would allow her a few seconds of heightened reactions, while everything around her appeared to slow down.

After the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], another user of Force speed was Darth Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Galen Marek]], who would use the Force to quickly cross short distances.<ref name="TFUg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]], also in the service of the Empire, was capable of enhancing his speed with the Force.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref> The Jedi [[Rachi Sitra]], who was on the list of the [[Emperor's Most Wanted]],<ref name="tcggh">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref> attempted to use Force-enhanced speed when facing the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] over Dathomir; however, Fett was able to disarm her with a [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] and she was captured.<ref name="uncivilized">{{SW|url=news/so-uncivilized-great-gunslingers-in-star-wars-part-1|series=So Uncivilized: Great Gunslingers in Star Wars|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

===New Jedi Order===
[[File:Force_Speed_Luke_Guri_EGTF.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker using Force Speed]]
It was a common ability among members of the [[New Jedi Order]], with many employing the technique including [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], [[Anakin Solo]],<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> [[Ulaha Kore]],<ref name="SbS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref> [[Thann Mithric]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]],<ref name="Betrayal">''[[Legacy of the Force: Betrayal]]''</ref> [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]],<ref name="Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> [[Tahiri Veila]],<ref name="EoV2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref><ref name="Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref> [[Kam Solusar]],<ref name="NJOSB">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> and [[Ben Skywalker]].<ref name="backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Kyle Katarn]] became proficient in this ability after using it for the first time on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to escape [[8t88/Legends|8t88's]] thugs.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''</ref> He would later use the technique to get access to the administrative tower of [[Barons Hed]].<ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" /> When returning to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after his absence, Katarn had to use this ability in a test prepared by Luke Skywalker to regain his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref> Katarn would later pass this ability on to his [[Padawan/Legends|student]] [[Jaden Korr]], who became skilled in its use during his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" /> and used it to augment his speed during a brief duel with ancient Jedi Relin Druur.<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], under the influence of ancient Sith Lord [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]], Jedi trainee [[Kyp Durron]] used the Force to work the controls of the [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Sun Crusher]]'' with Jedi speed to dodge the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] of the [[Caridan]] defense system, before he used the ''Sun Crusher'' to [[Destruction of Carida|destroy]] the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]].<ref name="CotF">''[[Champions of the Force]]''</ref>

[[File:Burst_Run.jpg|right|thumb|A Dark Jedi using Force speed.]]
Jedi and later Sith Lord [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was also a skilled and frequent user of the technique often using it in dangerous situations and combat.<ref name="Betrayal" /><ref name="Fury" /><ref name="traitor">''[[The New Jedi Order: Traitor]]''</ref><ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> During their first duel, Jaina Solo and Darth Caedus both called on the Force to exchange lightning-fast blows. Jaina experienced a powerful connection to the Force, enabling her to move faster than she ever could before; she believed she could even catch a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt between her fingers.<ref name="invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref> Fallen Jedi [[Alema Rar]] was also a proficient user of this technique, being able to move at speeds that surpassed that which her Jedi training should have allowed her.<ref name="Fury" /> Another skilled user of this technique was [[Valin Horn]]<ref name="Fury" /> who used this technique while under the influence of a Force [[Force psychosis|madness]] in an effort to escape his father, [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]], who he believed to be an impostor. Corran Horn also used this technique to keep up with his son as he attempted to bring Valin to his senses. Later after Valin Horn escaped Jedi custody, [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Masters' Council]] member [[Octa Ramis]] used a Force-aided burst of speed to gain distance for a jump to land on the classic [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] which Valin was using to escape.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> [[Seff Hellin]], who suffered from the same Force-related madness as Valin, was also capable of using this technique,<ref name="MFn">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> using it to escape pursuit while attempting to [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|rescue]] Valin from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]].<ref name="Outcast" /> When [[Sothais Saar]] also succumbed to the madness plaguing young Jedi, he displayed the ability to run at a speed that made him appear as a blur of motion while escaping from the Alliance [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]].<ref name="backlash" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', Speed when triggered, augments the game sprite's speed. In ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]'' this is not the case; the game around the player slows down while that of the player remains normal, signifying that the ability did not only augment his speed, but it altered the Jedi's perception of time.<ref name="Jedi Knight: Jedi Outcast" /><ref name="Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II" />

Kyle Katarn also made an appearance in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', which is set several months prior the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin IV]], before Katarn discovered that he was sensitive to the Force. However, in the game one of his special abilities is speed, which actually could be the untrained use of Force speed. This is supported by the fact that Force speed was the first Force power Katarn ever learned. A more mundane explanation could be that it is simply the same "sprint" ability that is also possessed by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] within the same game.<ref name="Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>

In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', it is possible for the player to learn the power Burst of Speed. The games have different levels of skill for the power, Knight Speed and Master Speed, which increase the player's defense and attack stats with use of the power.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> In the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook]], there are also different levels of the power named Knight Speed and Master Speed which allow the user to move at up to twenty times and thirty times faster than normal, respectively, and also increase a user's jumping distance.<ref name="Revised Core Rules" />

Force reflex, as shown as in ''Jedi Starfighter'' and the ''Jedi Knight'' series of games, is mechanically represented as an effect similar to Bullet time used in several other franchies including, perhaps most famously, those sources of The Matrix franchise.
